title: 第一卷 第21章 晚上和男人在一起很危险第一卷 第22章 这就是传说中的公狗腰吗
slug: 笨蛋美人当团宠师兄们抢疯了
content_zh:
;;
有些人天生没演技，更何况在沈长安的眼皮子底下，一切无所遁形。
他若有所思。
筑基期都没到，竟如此警觉吗？
此时在沈长安眼里的舒晩昭，和一只被吓到的猫没什么两样，偏偏这猫还装作很忙的样子，根本不知道已经被察觉到了小心思。
沈长安没有拆穿，若无其事地颔首，夸赞：“不错，就是这个，木灵花是炼制固元丹的主要材料。”
固元丹，可以巩固修为，宗门上百名弟子，每个月都能领到两枚。
对于弟子们来说僧多肉少，但对沈长安来说，一个月不仅要照顾宗门，还要炼制上百枚丹药。
不得不说，实在太拼了，一般人根本做不到。
舒晩昭萧然起敬，“大师兄，你太辛苦了。”
沈长安微笑：“知道我辛苦，就少闯点祸。”
舒晩昭：“……”
过分！
头可断血可流，祸不能不闯！
要让你失望了大师兄！
桀桀桀～
舒晩昭心里的小恶魔再次展露犄角，发出邪恶的笑声，拿着小叉子比比划划，准备崭露头角。
那枚玉牌舒晩昭没有还给沈长安。
沈长安也不介意。
毕竟他不需要玉牌也不会被结界阻拦。

为了防止引起他的怀疑，“聪明”的舒晩昭装模作样消停两天。
隐约觉得自己好像忘记了什么事情，但那都不重要。
没忘记任务就好。
接下来的流程如下。
上完早课，跟着他去清风阁处理宗门内务，中午她溜出去吃点东西，毕竟还没有辟谷，炼气期也是要吃饭的，宗门有特定的食堂，她觅完食再次被大师兄薅走。
她投喂完了，该投喂小动物们了。
她眼巴巴看着鹦鹉和各种小可爱们大战三百回合，意犹未尽地跟着沈长安去炼丹。
一般情况下，她都是打杂或者干看着，贴心的大师兄在炼丹房准备了一个软塌，让她闲来没事在软塌上待着。
这个时候，她无聊就会盯着他看。
都说男人认真做某件事的时候最帅。
大师兄不认真的时候就俊逸非凡，认真的时候更是惊为天人。
丹火晕染下，他白皙如玉的脸庞镀上了一层暖色，眼神平和而专注，修长的之间不断提炼药材中的杂质，速度极快，却很有秩序，举手投足之间皆是优雅从容。
那一瞬，他仿佛摒弃世界所有纷纷扰扰，更适合收敛了让舒晩昭害怕的诡谲感。
可是舒晩昭知道，这都是她的错觉。
因为系统一直提示，此时此刻，他的神识还锁定在她的身上，可怕的是如果不是系统提示，她根本察觉不到。
很可能掉落到他编织好的陷阱之中。
呵，诡计多端阴险狡诈卑鄙无耻的男人。
【宿主，没事不要念叨自己的人设，你已经摆烂多日，就不能多想想怎么完成任务吗？】
舒晩昭：“……”
她恼怒。

【没事不要偷听我的想法，不然我要弄你了。】
系统：【凤雏宿主打算怎么弄666.】
就宿主这笨蛋，骂人都翻来覆去那几个词，666系统有恃无恐。
【你不如其他系统。】

Some people are born with no acting skills, not to mention that under Shen Changan's nose, nothing can be hidden.
he mused.
The foundation building period has not even come yet, so why are you so alert?
In Shen Changan's eyes at this time, Shu Minzhao was no different from a frightened cat. However, the cat pretended to be very busy and had no idea that his little thoughts had been noticed.
Shen Changan did not expose it, and nodded calmly and praised: "Yes, that's it. Wood Spirit Flower is the main material for refining the Solid Yuan Pill."
Gu Yuan Dan can consolidate one's cultivation. Hundreds of disciples in the sect can receive two pills every month.
For the disciples, there are more monks than meat, but for Shen Chang'an, he not only has to take care of the sect, but also refines hundreds of pills.
I have to say, it’s so hard that most people can’t do it.
Shu Mingzhao respectfully said, "Senior Brother, you have worked too hard."
Shen Changan smiled: "You know I'm working hard, so I'll cause less trouble."
Shu Mingzhao: "..."
Too much!
The head can be severed and the blood can bleed, and disaster is inevitable!
I want to disappoint you, big brother!
Jiejiejie~
The little devil in Shu Minzhao showed his horns again, let out an evil laugh, and gestured with a small fork, preparing to show off.
Shu Mingzhao did not return the jade medal to Shen Changan.
Shen Changan didn't mind either.
After all, he doesn't need a jade token and won't be stopped by the barrier.
In order to avoid arousing his suspicion, the "smart" Shu Mingzhao pretended to stay quiet for two days.
I vaguely felt as if I had forgotten something, but it didn't matter.
Just don't forget the mission.
The next process is as follows.
After morning classes, she followed him to Qingfeng Pavilion to deal with the sect's internal affairs. At noon, she slipped out to eat something. After all, she had not gone without food yet, and she had to eat during the Qi refining period. The sect had a specific canteen. After she finished looking for food, she was taken away by her senior brother again.
She had finished feeding, and it was time to feed the little animals.
She eagerly watched the parrot fight with various cuties for three hundred rounds, and followed Shen Changan to refine elixirs with unsatisfied emotions.
Normally, she would do odd jobs or just watch. The considerate senior brother prepared a soft bed in the alchemy room for her to stay on the soft bed when she had nothing to do.
At this time, she would stare at him when she was bored.
It is said that men are most handsome when they are serious about something.
When the senior brother is not serious, he is extraordinary, and when he is serious, he is even more amazing.
Under the halo of the elixir fire, his fair and jade-like face was coated with a layer of warm color, his eyes were calm and focused, and his slender body was constantly refining the impurities in the medicinal materials. He was very fast but very orderly, and his movements were all elegant and calm.
At that moment, he seemed to have abandoned all the distractions in the world, and was more suitable to restrain the weirdness that scared Shu Zhaozhao.
But Shu Mingzhao knew that this was all her illusion.
Because the system kept reminding her, at this moment, his consciousness was still locked on her body. The scary thing was that if it hadn't been for the system prompt, she wouldn't have noticed it at all.
It is very possible to fall into the trap he has woven.
Ha, what a scheming, cunning, despicable and shameless man.
[Host, if you have nothing to do, don’t talk about your character. You have been showing off for many days, can’t you think more about how to complete the task? 】
Shu Mingzhao: "..."
She was annoyed.
[Don’t eavesdrop on my thoughts, otherwise I will get you. 】
System: [How does Fengchu host plan to get 666.]
As for the host, who is such an idiot and can only use a few words to curse people, the 666 system has nothing to fear.
[You are not as good as other systems. 】
